headlines.title: 油价上涨及美债收益率走高，令金价承压
headlines.summary: 因油价上涨和美国国债收益率走高，金价周二下跌，因前两者提高了持有无收益黄金的机会成本。不过，金价本月迄今仍上涨超过10%。三菱日联金融集团分析师表示“尽管如此，投资者需求回升以及各国央行增持黄金，仍为金价提供了支撑。展望未来，美联储7月会议纪要以及美联储主席沃什在杰克逊霍尔会议上的讲话，将成为判断利率前景的关键。”

headlines.title_en: Rising oil prices and higher U.S. Treasury yields weigh on gold prices
headlines.summary_en: Gold prices fell on Tuesday due to rising oil prices and higher U.S. Treasury yields, as both raised the opportunity cost of holding non-yielding gold. However, gold is still up more than 10% so far this month. Analysts at Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group said, "Nonetheless, recovering investor demand and central bank gold purchases continue to support gold prices. Looking ahead, the Fed's July meeting minutes and comments from Fed Chair Warsh at the Jackson Hole conference will be key to judging the interest rate outlook."

headlines.title_en: China Exim Bank issued nearly RMB 500 billion in new manufacturing loans in the first seven months
headlines.summary_en: Since the start of this year, the Export-Import Bank of China has leveraged its policy finance role, increased resource allocation, and fully supported high-quality manufacturing development, helping build a modern industrial system led by advanced manufacturing. From January to July this year, the bank issued nearly 500 billion yuan in new manufacturing loans, focusing on areas such as traditional industry transformation and upgrading, emerging industry growth, and forward-looking layout of future industries, of which advanced manufacturing loans totaled nearly 200 billion yuan, accounting for 40%. (CCTV News)

headlines.title_en: HSBC requires some existing mainland investment clients to submit source-of-funds declarations; failure to do so in time may lead to termination of related services
headlines.summary_en: According to National Business Daily, following the new account opening process requiring confirmation that funds come from legitimate overseas sources, some banks in Hong Kong have begun requiring existing mainland investment clients to declare their source of funds. A reporter learned that HSBC Hong Kong has recently been sending notices to some existing mainland investment clients, requiring them to submit a "Declaration for Opening/Maintaining Accounts" via the HSBC Hong Kong app by September 12 and update contact information. The declaration confirms that funds for investment activities come from legitimate sources outside mainland China and that the bank may disclose personal information at the request of law enforcement or regulatory authorities.

headlines.title_en: China Unicom (H-share): H1 2026 revenue RMB 201.4 billion; computing power revenue RMB 41.9 billion, up 13% year-on-year
headlines.summary_en: China Unicom announced on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange: First-half 2026 revenue was stable, with operating revenue of RMB 201.4 billion, up 0.6% year-on-year, despite challenges in overall industry growth. Profitability faced short-term pressure due to changes in VAT and labor cost investment timing, with full-year profit decline expected to narrow significantly. First-half 2026 net profit was RMB 9.5 billion, down 34.6% year-on-year. Computing power revenue was RMB 41.9 billion, up 13% year-on-year, with intelligent computing center revenue up 11% and intelligent computing revenue up 9%.

headlines.title_en: U.S. stock movers: WeRide shares extend pre-market gains by 3%, supported by 5.8% surge in H-shares; multiple institutions turn bullish after earnings
headlines.summary_en: WeRide's Hong Kong shares rose 5.8% today, also driving WeRide (WRD.US) U.S. pre-market shares up another 3%. On the news front, the company recently reported first-half total revenue of 346 million yuan, up 73% year-on-year. The second quarter was particularly strong, with revenue of 232 million yuan, up 82% year-on-year and 103% quarter-on-quarter, significantly beating market expectations. China Merchants Securities believes the company's Q2 performance was impressive with clear core growth logic; BofA Securities maintained a "Buy" rating on WeRide post-results, with the target price unchanged at $10.7.

headlines.title: 群核科技增资至16.91亿
